paper_metadata.title: Microstructures and mechanical behavior of non-equiatomic Co29Cr29Fe29Ni13-xVx high-entropy alloys at room and cryogenic temperatures

evidence.quote: A series of non-equiatomic Co29Cr29Fe29Ni13-xVx (x = 0, 0.5, 3, and 5) high-entropy alloys (HEAs) with fully recrystallized microstructures were prepared by rolling and annealing.
